description: Compares words in two files and reports differences.

option.name: --auto-pager
tip: Automatically call a pager.

option.name: --avoid-wraps
tip: Do not extend fields through newlines.

option.name: --copyright
tip: Display copyright information then exit.

option.name: --diff-input
tip: Use a single unified diff as input.

option.name: --end-delete
tip: String to mark the end of a deleted region.

option.name: --end-insert
tip: String to mark the end of an inserted region.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this help then exit.

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: Fold character case while comparing.

option.name: --less-mode
tip: Use a variation of printer mode for "less".

option.name: --no-common
tip: Inhibit output of common words.

option.name: --no-deleted
tip: Inhibit output of deleted words.

option.name: --no-init-term
tip: Now synonymous to --terminal, which never initializes the terminal.
(deprecated, use --terminal instead)

option.name: --no-inserted
tip: Inhibit output of inserted words.

option.name: --printer
tip: Use overstrike as for printers.

option.name: --start-delete
tip: String to mark the beginning of a deleted region.

option.name: --start-insert
tip: String to mark the beginning of an inserted region.

option.name: --statistics
tip: Report how many words were deleted, inserted, and so on.

option.name: --terminal
tip: Use termcap as for terminal displays.

option.name: --version
tip: Display program version then exit.
